[Benzinga news, 2026-10-22T13:31:55Z, by staff] AbbVie Announces Positive Phase 3 Results for Lutikizumab in Hidradenitis Suppurativa
AbbVie reported topline results from the Phase 3 INTREPID trial, demonstrating that lutikizumab significantly improved signs and symptoms in patients with hidradenitis suppurativa.
AbbVie announced positive topline data from its Phase 3 INTREPID clinical trial evaluating the efficacy and safety of lutikizumab for the treatment of hidradenitis suppurativa. The study met its primary endpoint, showing that patients treated with lutikizumab experienced significant improvements in the signs and symptoms of the disease compared to those receiving a placebo. These results represent a key milestone in the company's immunology pipeline. The company intends to share these findings with regulatory authorities and present the data at upcoming medical congresses.
